entryPoints.devServerLocal: BABYLON_ASSET_DIR=work/babylon-golden-map npm run dev:babylon  (port 5173 free; add --full for full-load gate)
entryPoints.devServerCdn: npm run dev:babylon  (port 5173; dev ticket rewrite + img.yuluo.site proxy; CDN throttles repeated full loads)

environmentNotes: Node 20.11.1 at E:/nodejs must be on PATH for npm lifecycle scripts (postinstall spawns cmd.exe).
The CDN only sends CORS headers for https://yuluo.site. Dev servers rewrite ticket URLs to same-origin via the middleware in vite.babylon.config.js (dev/preview only).
yuluo.site/ff14-assets/* serves the SPA, not assets; only img.yuluo.site serves versioned assets.
Repeated full-map streams over the CDN hit ECONNRESET throttling. Local mode via BABYLON_ASSET_DIR=work/babylon-golden-map fully loads e3t1 in ~11s and is the default for workbench loops.
Headless Chromium needs --use-gl=angle for GPU rendering (software WebGL renders at ~6 fps and stalls material upgrades).
Known pre-existing render quirks at kugane-castle baseline: floating stair/roof slabs over water planes, flat water shading; recorded, not fixed in this task.
